usedFor: MailerLite holds subscribers and campaigns, and Google Sheets keeps the row that “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes after “Subscriber Unsubscribed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscriber Unsubscribed” in MailerLite, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: An unsubscribe is a status worth recording, and the action updates columns in a sheet row.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” changes an existing row, so the subscriber’s row must exist before “Subscriber Bounced” reaches it.
